fit_3d_joints_to_adam_model: fit 3D joint coordinates to the ADAM body model using meshWrapper.fit_total3d with a numpy array
visualize_fitted_mesh: render the fitted ADAM mesh as a PIL Image using meshWrapper.total_visualize with camera mode and scale options
fit_2d_joints_with_calibration: fit 2D joint keypoints to the ADAM model using meshWrapper.fit_total2d with a camera calibration matrix
fit_PAF_vec_with_joints: fit pose using PAF vectors and 2D joints via meshWrapper.fit_PAF_vec with optional 3D joint input
refit_adam_with_regressor: refit the ADAM model parameters from 3D joints using meshWrapper.adam_refit with a specified regressor type
